name: kxredistricting
title: Will Arizona adopt new congressional district maps before Nov 1, 2026?
settlement: Resolves YES if the Arizona legislature formally adopts and enacts new, qualifying congressional district maps after issuance and before Nov 1, 2026, and those maps are not enjoined/vacated/struck down and are in effect for the next federal election. Resolves NO if no new maps are adopted, maps are withdrawn, or a court completely redraws the maps.
decideContext: You are estimating how much a news item shifts the implied probability (in percentage points) that Arizona will have adopted and enacted qualifying new congressional maps, surviving legal challenges, before Nov 1, 2026.
